context: Reference focused implementation: block callbacks with temporary values and branching should become named helpers while preserving behavior.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates EscalationReport.java with the requested method, nested records, imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves escalation behavior
checklist.description: Preserves filtering for open, assigned, non-snoozed tickets; uses Instant.now(clock); computes age from openedAt to now; marks priority at least 8 or age at least 48 hours as urgent; and preserves encounter order.

checklist.name: Extracts block mapping logic
checklist.description: Moves the mapping callback's temporary Duration, branching, and TicketEscalation construction into a named helper or equivalent named method rather than keeping a block lambda or multi-line callback body.

checklist.name: Names the predicate rule
checklist.description: Extracts or clearly names the multi-condition ticket eligibility predicate instead of leaving several meaningful checks buried in a wrapped callback.

checklist.name: Keeps refactor focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated caching, concurrency, dependencies, API redesign, public helper expansion, or broad style rewrites.
